item.description: Quotation: sgadan bhuntàta. Notes: herring caught for home consumption.
Notes: horizontal slats put on kiln.
Quotation: sgadan bhuntàta. Notes: herring caught for horse consumption.
Quotation: Dh’fhairtich e orm a dheanamh. Notes: I failed to do it. (Without the “l”.)
[fɑʴsṯəmɑ̃ṉ] Notes: thin line which attaches a hook to the main line. [NOTES: the turned r used for the symbol which is unclear in the original.]
